page.layout: One page of running text in a single full-width block at the top, with the paragraph continuing from the previous page and a short centred paragraph closing it. The lower two-thirds of the scan shows only show-through from the reverse side and stains. Running head at top, page number at top right.

main_text.p: Ob hanc imperiam Regni gerendi, totiusque vitæ segnitiem, cum animos etiam vulgi Prorex offendisset, tum ob alia, iudicis fiebat vilior: præcipue, post sublatum Georgium Sophocardium, maxima parte hominum secutas calamitates in Religionem vertente: sed iis maxime, qui non modo puritatem doctrinæ, & vitæ totius moderationem in Georgio suspiciebant: sed qui multis & eius veracissimis prædictionibus persuasi, vim futuri perspiciendi diuinitus ei inditam credebant. Vilescente, ob hæc, interim Proregis auctoritate, mox & secutum malum, multo latius fusum, quod omnium querelas, nec eas quidem obscuras, expressit: Conuentibus enim iuridicis, per vniuersum Regnum, indictis, verbo quidem, vt latrocinia comprimerentur: verum res ipsa ostendit, nihil aliud, quam publicam direptionem, sub honestis nominibus, quæstu: Ab vniuersis enim exorquebatur pecunia: & a bonis viris, & latronibus æqualis multa exigebatur: & vtrique, non pro magnitudine scelerum, sed opum, plectebantur. Nec a sincerae Religionis cultoribus abstinebat crudelitatem & auaritiam, etsi ipse aliquando eam sectam professus fuisset: nec tum haberent Cardi-nalem, sub cuius nominis prætextu sua vitia[?] tegerent.
Nec, Proregis nomine, pecunia turpius quæ-rebatur, quam flagitiosius, libidine fratris, profundebatur.

page.notes: Heavy show-through from the reverse side covers the lower page; not transcribed. A faint "E e" mark in the middle of the page, a small ornament at the top centre, and scattered specks/bullets beside the text are not printed text and were omitted. "pleCtebantur" read as "plectebantur" (ct ligature), uncertain. "vicia" in the last line: read as "vitia" with doubt. "exiorquebatur" as printed; likely "exorquebatur" in the scan. Hyphens "Cardi-nalem" and "quæ-rebatur" are line-end hyphens as printed.
